vectors.description: PUBLISH_STATE_NOTIFY with no parameters. The message has no Request ID field: it is identified by the subscription's request stream it arrives on

PUBLISH_STATE_NOTIFY carrying LARGEST_OBJECT (group=10, object=3). Section 9.10: the publisher MUST include it if known. LARGEST_OBJECT is Parameter Type 0x09, odd, but a Location: two bare vi64s with no length prefix. The Key-Value-Pair parity rule does not apply to Message Parameters

PUBLISH_STATE_NOTIFY reporting that the subscription is paused at the publisher: PAUSED (0x11) = 1. Section 9.19.18: "When sent in PUBLISH_STATE_NOTIFY, it reports whether the subscription is paused at the publisher." Draft-22 reported the same state as FORWARD (0x10) = 0
PUBLISH_STATE_NOTIFY reporting the Location Filter now in effect at the publisher: a type 0x03 filter, the inclusive range {12,0} through all of group 16
PUBLISH_STATE_NOTIFY carrying LARGEST_OBJECT (group=7, object=41) and PAUSED=0; the PAUSED Type Delta is 8, from 0x09 to 0x11

PUBLISH_STATE_NOTIFY carrying every parameter draft-23 permits in it: LARGEST_OBJECT (0x09), PAUSED (0x11) and LOCATION_FILTER (0x21). Section 9.10: "The parameters that can appear in a PUBLISH_STATE_NOTIFY are LARGEST_OBJECT, PAUSED and LOCATION_FILTER."

PUBLISH_STATE_NOTIFY carrying draft-22's FORWARD (0x10) = 0. Draft-23's Table 14 has no row for 0x10: PAUSED (0x11) replaced FORWARD. Section 9.19: "An endpoint that receives an unknown Message Parameter MUST close the session with INVALID_PARAMETER."
vectors.error_detail: message parameter type 0x10 is not defined by draft-23

vectors.description: PUBLISH_STATE_NOTIFY with PAUSED (0x11) = 2. Section 9.19.18: "The allowed values are 0 (unpaused) or 1 (paused). If an endpoint receives a value outside this range, it MUST close the session with INVALID_PARAMETER."

PUBLISH_STATE_NOTIFY carrying EXPIRES (0x08). Section 9.10: "The parameters that can appear in a PUBLISH_STATE_NOTIFY are LARGEST_OBJECT, PAUSED and LOCATION_FILTER." Section 9.19.1: "If a parameter appears in some other type of message, the receiving endpoint MUST close the session with INVALID_PARAMETER."
